summary: Shows group variables used in Jinja2 templates (ntp.conf), plus template conditionals and loops, such as opening port 3306 only on dbservers and allowing each monitoring host's IP via hostvars.
questions: How do I use variables inside an Ansible template?
How do I add a config line only for hosts in a certain group?
How can a template loop over hosts in another group to get their IPs?

answer_card.title: Variables, conditionals and loops in templates
